author_tests: Independently reran 9 model-free tests: 9 passed in 1.06s.

findings.issue: Supervisor actual disk check subtracts per-run initial_size and does not enforce total phase disk usage or per-packet reservation. Guard only sums declared reservations. Fast successful child exit also bypasses final disk/free-space limit validation.
findings.required_fix: Bind supervisor to exact packet disk allowance and enforce aggregate actual phase size including prior outputs; check final size/free reserve after child exit; preserve failed reservation and receipt.

findings.issue: Hooks registered before DynamicCache construction, which is outside try/finally. Cache initialization failure leaves hooks installed.
findings.required_fix: Put hook registration and cache preparation inside cleanup-protected try/finally; test setup failures as well as forward failures.

findings.issue: Manifest identity mismatch found during verification; refreeze changed artifact and independently review exact candidate before admission.
